problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 2 & -1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,W=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $W,$ and the vector $b$ above. If the normal equation for the corresponding weighted least-squares problem $W\,Ax=Wb$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 0 \\ 0 & b\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$
